constraints.claim:
(exists ((bound_priorClaim type_Event) (bound_laterClaim type_Event))
  (and (predicates_Achievement entity_Sylvester bound_priorClaim)
       (predicates_Achievement entity_Sylvester bound_laterClaim)
       (< (functions_Time bound_priorClaim) (functions_Time bound_laterClaim))
       (<= 20200000 (functions_Time bound_laterClaim))))
evidence:
(exists ((bound_only type_Event))
  (and (predicates_Achievement entity_Sylvester bound_only)
       (<= 20190000 (functions_Time bound_only))
       (> 20200000 (functions_Time bound_only))
       (forall ((bound_other type_Event))
         (=> (predicates_Achievement entity_Sylvester bound_other)
             (= bound_other bound_only)))))
